items.exampleEn: The ship's red smokestack could be seen from far away.
items.exampleZh: 那艘船的紅色煙囪從很遠的地方就看得見。

items.exampleEn: She wears an antipollution mask when she rides her bike in the city.
items.exampleZh: 她在市區騎單車時會戴防霾口罩。

items.exampleEn: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.
items.exampleZh: 植物吸收二氧化碳，釋放出氧氣。

items.exampleEn: The website shows the carbon footprint of each product.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站列出每項產品的碳足跡。

items.exampleEn: Carbon monoxide is a gas with no color and no smell.
items.exampleZh: 一氧化碳是一種無色無味的氣體。

items.exampleEn: Scientists study ancient ice to learn about climate change in the past.
items.exampleZh: 科學家研究古老的冰層，以了解過去的氣候變遷。

items.exampleEn: The hotel uses environmentally friendly soap made from plants.
items.exampleZh: 那家飯店使用以植物製成的環保肥皂。

items.exampleEn: Our science teacher asked us to make a poster about global warming.
items.exampleZh: 自然老師要我們做一張關於全球暖化的海報。

items.exampleEn: Many young designers want their brands to feel glocal, mixing world trends with local culture.
items.exampleZh: 許多年輕設計師希望自己的品牌有全球在地化的感覺，把國際潮流和在地文化結合在一起。

items.sentenceEn: Cars and factories send a lot of carbon dioxide into the air.
items.sentenceZh: 汽車和工廠把大量二氧化碳排放到空氣中。

items.audioEn: Our school is trying to be more environmentally friendly, so please bring your own cup tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 我們學校正努力變得更環保，所以明天請自備杯子。
items.questionZh: 說話者請大家明天怎麼做？

items.sentenceEn: Old gas heaters can produce carbon monoxide when they are not working well.
items.sentenceZh: 老舊的燃氣暖爐運作不良時，可能會產生一氧化碳。

items.sentenceEn: The company has a glocal plan: one global brand with local products in every country.
items.sentenceZh: 那家公司有一套全球在地化的計畫：一個全球品牌，每個國家都有在地產品。

items.stemEn: Gray smoke rose from the tall ____ of the old power station.
items.stemZh: 灰色的煙霧從老發電廠高高的煙囪裡升起。

items.stemEn: Rising sea levels are one effect of ____ that worries island countries.
items.stemZh: 海平面上升是讓島國擔憂的全球暖化影響之一。

items.passageEn: Last week, our class visited an old industrial town that is trying to change. Its tall smokestacks once filled the sky with smoke, but most of the factories have now closed. The town has new antipollution rules, and buses run on electricity. A local guide, a well-known ecologist, explained that burning coal releases carbon dioxide, which is linked to global warming and climate change. Some families now measure their carbon footprint and try to live in an environmentally friendly way. The town even calls itself glocal: local craft makers now design products for buyers in different countries while keeping the town's own style. We left feeling hopeful about the future.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們班去參觀一個正努力轉型的老工業城鎮。那裡高大的煙囪曾經讓天空布滿煙霧，不過現在大部分工廠都關了。小鎮訂了新的防治汙染規定，公車也改用電力行駛。一位在地導覽員是知名的生態學家，他說明，燃燒煤炭會釋放二氧化碳，這和全球暖化、氣候變遷有關。現在有些家庭會計算自己的碳足跡，並試著以環保的方式生活。小鎮甚至自稱「全球在地化」：在地工藝師為不同國家的買家設計產品，同時保有小鎮自己的風格。我們離開時，對未來充滿希望。

questions.questionZh: 小鎮的公車現在用什麼行駛？
小鎮為什麼自稱「全球在地化」？
options: 外國公司在那裡蓋工廠
為各國設計並保有在地特色

items.promptZh: 搭公車而不開車，可以減少你的碳足跡。
referenceEn: Taking the bus instead of driving can reduce your carbon footprint.
You can lower your carbon footprint by taking the bus instead of driving.
rubricZh: 要用 carbon footprint（例如 reduce your carbon footprint）

items.promptZh: 氣候變遷讓這個地區的冬天越來越短。
referenceEn: Climate change is making winters in this area shorter and shorter.
Because of climate change, winters in this region are getting shorter.
rubricZh: climate change 指氣候變遷，不加冠詞
「越來越短」可寫，例如 shorter and shorter、are getting shorter 等
時態可用現在進行式、現在式或現在完成式（例如 is making、makes、has made 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：用法不精確：glocal 指「全球思維＋在地調整」（如 q13 跟讀句：全球品牌、各國在地產品），文中 "it sells local crafts to buyers around the world" 只是在地產品外銷，算不上 glocal；第 #1 小題答案建立在這個定義上，會教錯詞義。建議改成例如「把在地手工藝改成符合各國買家需求的設計」。
